sso_required: This e-mail domain must sign in with the organization's identity provider. Use the "Sign in with …" button.
password_login_disabled: The organization policy turned off password sign-in. Sign in with the identity provider or your directory account.
password_too_short: The password is shorter than the organization policy allows.
password_breached: This password appears in a known data breach. Choose another one.
idp_unavailable: The identity provider or directory could not be reached. Try again shortly; tell your administrator if it continues.
idp_config_invalid: The identity provider settings are invalid.
idp_kind_mismatch: The settings do not match this connection's type.
sso_login_failed: Sign-in with the identity provider could not be completed. Try again.
sso_account_not_linked: No account matches this identity. Ask an administrator of your organization for an invitation.
sso_email_conflict: An account with this e-mail already exists and automatic linking is off. Tell your administrator.
sso_email_unverified: The identity provider did not report the e-mail address as verified.
sso_access_denied: Your account is suspended or not allowed to sign in to this organization.
ldap_disabled: Directory sign-in is not enabled in this organization.
ip_not_allowed: Access to this area from your network is blocked by the organization policy.
ip_allowlist_self_lockout: Your current IP address is not in the list; saving would lock you out. Add your own range first.
identity_reauth_required: Confirm your identity again to make this change.
oidc_consent_invalid: The sign-in request is invalid. Go back to the app and try again.
oidc_access_denied: You are not allowed to sign in to this app. Ask your organization administrator.
oidc_client_id_taken: This client ID is used by another app.
oidc_redirect_uri_invalid: Invalid redirect URI: it must be a full address without wildcards; http only for localhost.
legal_hold: This content is under legal hold and cannot be deleted.
dlp_warning: The message may contain sensitive data. Send it anyway?
dlp_blocked: This content matched the organization's data loss rule and was not sent.
identity_reauth_failed: Verification did not go through. Try again or verify with your password.
